announcements.title: Blue Lock Clicker 0.4.0 Update
body: Blue Lock Clicker has been updated to version 0.4.0.
- Some UI fixes in minigame hub.
- Trapping Minigame nerfed to 20 needed to win.
- Removed Chigiri and Bachira from their own minigames.

announcements.title: Cubo 0.3.0 Update
body: Cubo has been updated to version 0.3.0.
- Added keyboard and controller support for easier menu navigation.
- Moved the location of the Grump Rock cooler.
- Changed the elevator logic so that the elevator starts when the player is on it.
- Added more corner tiles that were missed on the map.
- Changed the size of buttons in the Main Menu.
- Revamped the look of the starting area.
- Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash when switching tabs

announcements.title: Momentum Bound v2.1.0 Update
body: Momentum Bound has been updated to version 2.1.0.
- Added a story tab that unlocks after beating final boss
- Fixed collider error where you could get stuck on doors
- Fixed room zone to keep trapdoor open
